text:
Maya: quick design ping 1 small-copy tweak for the dashboard confirmation modal. Current full sentence reads long on narrow windows and the secondary action gets pushed below. want very tight wording + a11y checklist.
Jared: propose 'Stop pool and release GPUs.' vs 'Stop pool (release GPUs)'. shorter but explicit.
Evelyn: prefer shorter imperatives. also need to ensure the live region announces when the modal opens. role="dialog" plus aria-modal.
Sam: i like 'Stop pool and release GPUs.' for clarity. button labels: primary 'Stop' secondary 'Cancel'.
Maya: throwing three microcopy options for the lead line:
  1) 'Stop pool and release GPUs.'
  2) 'Stop pool now. GPUs will be released.'
  3) 'Stop this pool and free its GPUs.'
Which is clearest at small widths?
Jared: 1 is shortest. 3 reads friendlier but longer. 2 might wrap badly. choose 1.
Evelyn: accessibility notes:
  - ensure dialog has focus trap and initial focus on the primary action for keyboard users? careful: default focus on destructive actions can be risky. better: focus the dialog container and the primary button is reachable via tab, plus visually emphasize primary.
  - aria-describedby should point to the lead copy so screen readers announce it.
  - color/contrast: 'Stop' button uses red token. must be >=3:1 against adjacent elements for a large button and 4.5:1 for small text.
Maya: agree on not auto-focusing destructive button. set initial focus on dialog title, let tab reach Stop. add data-testid for modal-copy for tests.
Sam: microcopy for confirmation checkbox (optional): 'I understand stopping will interrupt in-flight requests.' maybe shorten to 'I understand this will interrupt active requests.'
Evelyn: shorten more: 'I understand this will interrupt requests.' still clear and fits one line on narrow.
Maya: ok landing plan: use option 1 for the lead line, primary label 'Stop', secondary 'Cancel', checkbox copy 'I understand this will interrupt requests.' add aria-describedby and role=dialog, no autofocus on Stop, update red token contrast. will PR to ui/modals branch and drop link here.
copybot: microcopy extras: if we add an expanded help link, use 'What happens to my jobs?' not 'More info'.
Jared: add an automated test for aria-describedby mapping and that dialog title has role=heading.
Maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/3120 1 includes copy tokens and accessibility updates. please review.
copybot: :white_check_mark: lint passed.
Maya: thanks all, will run canary for 3 days and monitor cancel rates.
